documents_stored_or_read.name: documents_stored_or_read
documents_stored_or_read.value: "documents"."storage_key" is not null or "documents"."simulated" or "documents"."extraction" is not null

payees_caregiver_rate.name: payees_caregiver_rate
payees_caregiver_rate.value: "payees"."caregiver_rate_cents_per_hour" is null or ("payees"."member_id" is not null and "payees"."caregiver_rate_cents_per_hour" > 0 and "payees"."caregiver_rate_cents_per_hour" <= 9007199254740991)

payees_shift_rules.name: payees_shift_rules
payees_shift_rules.value: shift_minimum_minutes between 0 and 1440 and shift_overtime_percent between 100 and 300 and (shift_overtime_after_minutes is null or shift_overtime_after_minutes between 1 and 1440)

payees_auto_pay_complete.name: payees_auto_pay_complete
payees_auto_pay_complete.value:
("payees"."auto_pay_rule_id" is null and "payees"."auto_pay_min_cents" is null and "payees"."auto_pay_max_cents" is null)
        or ("payees"."auto_pay_rule_id" is not null and "payees"."auto_pay_min_cents" > 0 and "payees"."auto_pay_max_cents" >= "payees"."auto_pay_min_cents")

care_entries_shift_has_entry.name: care_entries_shift_has_entry
care_entries_shift_has_entry.value: "care_entries"."shift_id" is null or ("care_entries"."approved" and "care_entries"."ledger_entry_id" is not null)

invoice_requests_period.name: invoice_requests_period
invoice_requests_period.value: ("invoice_requests"."purpose" = 'settlement') = ("invoice_requests"."period" is not null) and ("invoice_requests"."period" is null or period ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$')

invoice_requests_simulated_has_no_paypal.name: invoice_requests_simulated_has_no_paypal
invoice_requests_simulated_has_no_paypal.value: not "invoice_requests"."simulated" or ("invoice_requests"."recipient" is null and "invoice_requests"."paypal_invoice_id" is null)

invoice_requests_sent_has_invoice.name: invoice_requests_sent_has_invoice
invoice_requests_sent_has_invoice.value: "invoice_requests"."state" not in ('sent', 'paid') or "invoice_requests"."simulated" or "invoice_requests"."paypal_invoice_id" is not null

invoice_requests_paid_has_payment.name: invoice_requests_paid_has_payment
invoice_requests_paid_has_payment.value: ("invoice_requests"."state" = 'paid') = ("invoice_requests"."payment_id" is not null and "invoice_requests"."paid_at" is not null)

shift_permissions_caps.name: shift_permissions_caps
shift_permissions_caps.value: per_shift_cents > 0 and per_shift_cents <= 9007199254740991 and max_minutes_per_day between 1 and 1440

shifts_title.name: shifts_title
shifts_title.value: "shifts"."title" is null or length(trim("shifts"."title")) between 1 and 120

shifts_taps_in_order.name: shifts_taps_in_order
shifts_taps_in_order.value: ("shifts"."checked_out_at" is null or ("shifts"."checked_in_at" is not null and "shifts"."checked_out_at" > "shifts"."checked_in_at"))

shifts_family_word_whole.name: shifts_family_word_whole
shifts_family_word_whole.value: ("shifts"."family_confirmed_at" is null) = ("shifts"."family_confirmed_by" is null) and ("shifts"."family_confirmed_at" is null) = ("shifts"."family_confirmation" is null) and ("shifts"."family_confirmation" is null or "shifts"."family_confirmation" in ('parent', 'sibling'))

shifts_state_matches_keys.name: shifts_state_matches_keys
shifts_state_matches_keys.value:
("shifts"."state" <> 'scheduled' or ("shifts"."checked_in_at" is null and "shifts"."family_confirmed_at" is null))
        and ("shifts"."state" <> 'checked_in' or ("shifts"."checked_in_at" is not null and "shifts"."checked_out_at" is null))
        and ("shifts"."state" <> 'checked_out' or ("shifts"."checked_out_at" is not null and "shifts"."family_confirmed_at" is null))
        and ("shifts"."state"::text not in ('confirmed', 'priced', 'paid', 'credited') or ("shifts"."checked_out_at" is not null and "shifts"."family_confirmed_at" is not null))

shifts_priced_has_proposal.name: shifts_priced_has_proposal
shifts_priced_has_proposal.value: ("shifts"."state" in ('priced', 'paid')) = ("shifts"."proposal_id" is not null and "shifts"."cents" is not null and "shifts"."worked_minutes" is not null and "shifts"."billable_minutes" is not null and "shifts"."rate_cents_per_hour" is not null)

shifts_evidence_with_word.name: shifts_evidence_with_word
shifts_evidence_with_word.value: "shifts"."family_evidence_ref" is null or ("shifts"."family_confirmed_at" is not null and length("shifts"."family_evidence_ref") between 1 and 100)

shifts_permission_needs_proposal.name: shifts_permission_needs_proposal
shifts_permission_needs_proposal.value: "shifts"."permission_id" is null or "shifts"."proposal_id" is not null

shifts_price_in_range.name: shifts_price_in_range
shifts_price_in_range.value: (cents is null or (cents > 0 and cents <= 9007199254740991)) and (rate_cents_per_hour is null or rate_cents_per_hour > 0) and (worked_minutes is null or worked_minutes between 1 and 1440) and (billable_minutes is null or billable_minutes between worked_minutes and 1440)

care_agreements_duties.name: care_agreements_duties
care_agreements_duties.value: array_ndims(duties) = 1 and array_position(duties, null) is null and array_to_string(duties, E'\x01') ~ '^[^<>\x01\s]([^<>\x01]{0,198}[^<>\x01\s])?(\x01[^<>\x01\s]([^<>\x01]{0,198}[^<>\x01\s])?){0,11}$'

care_agreements_fixed_end.name: care_agreements_fixed_end
care_agreements_fixed_end.value: ("care_agreements"."end_term" = 'fixed_end_date') = ("care_agreements"."ends_on" is not null) and ("care_agreements"."ends_on" is null or "care_agreements"."ends_on" > "care_agreements"."starts_on")

trusted_voices_receiver.name: trusted_voices_receiver
trusted_voices_receiver.value: ("trusted_voices"."paypal_receiver" is null) = ("trusted_voices"."receiver_confirmed_at" is null) and ("trusted_voices"."paypal_receiver" is null or "trusted_voices"."paypal_receiver" ~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+\.[^@[:space:]]+$')

purse_payees_verified.name: purse_payees_verified
purse_payees_verified.value: ("purse_payees"."verified_by" is null) = ("purse_payees"."verified_at" is null) and ("purse_payees"."verified_by" is null or "purse_payees"."verified_by" <> "purse_payees"."added_by")

purse_payments_route.name: purse_payments_route
purse_payments_route.value: route is null or route in ('paypal', 'gift_card', 'crypto', 'wire', 'cash', 'unknown')

purse_payments_texts.name: purse_payments_texts
purse_payments_texts.value: length(btrim(payee_name)) between 1 and 80 and length(words) between 1 and 500 and (memo is null or length(memo) between 1 and 120) and length(read_back) between 1 and 600

purse_payments_answer.name: purse_payments_answer
purse_payments_answer.value: ("purse_payments"."answered_at" is null) = ("purse_payments"."answer_method" is null) and ("purse_payments"."answer_method" is null or "purse_payments"."answer_method" in ('app', 'voice'))

purse_payments_hold.name: purse_payments_hold
purse_payments_hold.value: ("purse_payments"."held_at" is null) = ("purse_payments"."hold_ends_at" is null) and ("purse_payments"."held_at" is null or cardinality("purse_payments"."hold_reasons") > 0)

purse_payments_cancelled.name: purse_payments_cancelled
purse_payments_cancelled.value: ("purse_payments"."cancelled_at" is null) = ("purse_payments"."cancelled_by" is null) and (not "purse_payments"."pressured" or "purse_payments"."cancelled_at" is not null)
